snippet.title: Island Survival: Escape from Paradise - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Add it to your wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3138840/Island_Survival_Escape_from_Paradise/

Island Survival: Escape from Paradise is a casual 3D game in which you'll have to help a group of castaways to escape from a tropical island. For this, you'll have to assign them some tasks, like collecting water or building a boat. But they will have their own abilities and preferences, so they may refuse to do a task they don't like, or cause some accidents if they're bad at something. It's your job to discover and remember castaways' likes and abilities in order to assign the most apropriate tasks to each one.
